newsitem.title: CHINA: Wah Tak Fung, Sun Fook Kong suspended.
newsitem.headline: Wah Tak Fung, Sun Fook Kong suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd and Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd was suspended on Tuesday afternoon at the companies' request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock Exchange said.

Property and investment group Wah Tak Fung said last Friday its was negotiating a share issue representing about 25 percent of its existing issued share capital to a Hong Kong listed company and a definitive agreement was expected to be singed on Tuesday.
But Wah Tak Fung did not identify the company which would subscribe its shares. Its shares jumped HK$0.125, or 5.68 percent, to close Tuesday morning at HK$2.325.
Sun Fook Kong shares lost HK$0.35 to HK$7.50 before trading was suspended.

Sun Fook Kong had said it would change name to Hing Kong Holdings Ltd to reflect the change in control of the company after China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd bought a 51.66 percent stake in the company. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
